a.lede: Nvidia's ousted CEO Jensen Huang's downfall isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire sex scandal. He was using his influence to push the AI industry in some very specific ways.

b.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns as CEO in the wake of multiple affairs, Chinese spy allegations
